The Level 1 session uses direct recognition and basic understanding checks appropriate for an introductory unit, with no unsupported advanced implementation requirements.

The artifact consistently distinguishes client application, server/model deployment, Foundry portal, Playground, Foundry resource, Foundry project, endpoint, API, and REST request in line with the source terminology.

The session is source-faithful and structurally valid, but its repetitive true/false clusters, definition-heavy prompts, limited authentic context, and generic explanations reduce instructional richness.
